title: UGTA federations’ protest gathering at union headquarters over draft union and strike laws
scope: One reported gathering at the union headquarters; broader organizer reach is unresolved.
organizer: UGTA federations, as described by contemporary reports.
threshold_50_evidence: Pending. The opened reports establish a gathering but give no attendee estimate. S015 reports about ten UGTA structures, which is a count of organizations, not people. The search-only S017 lead does not establish turnout. No numeric minimum of 50 is supported.

occurrence.summary: TSA and La Sentinelle describe an UGTA federations’ protest gathering at the union headquarters over the government’s draft union-activity and labor-dispute/strike laws.

start_date.summary: Date is contested: S015’s 25 January publication says “yesterday” (24 January); S014 says “Wednesday 26 January,” an internally inconsistent weekday/date; search-only S017 refers to a Wednesday gathering without a firm day. Preserve month precision.

location.summary: Both opened reports place the gathering at UGTA headquarters in Algiers.

organizer.summary: Reports attribute the gathering to UGTA federations; S015 also mentions around ten structures, which is not an attendee count.

demands.summary: Withdrawal or correction of government draft laws on union activity and collective labor disputes/strike rights.

participants_original.summary: The opened reports provide no participant number. S015’s count of about ten structures is organizational, not individual turnout; S017 remains search-only.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No body-verified numeric or clear qualitative attendee count establishes at least 50 people.

protester_violence.summary: Event-specific protester conduct is not reported; silence does not establish absence.

state_response.summary: These accounts do not establish event-specific accommodation, arrests, beatings, dispersal, ignore, killings, or shootings; each response remains unknown.

end_date.summary: No physical end time or date is reported; publication and announced next action do not establish when the gathering ended.

notes: The date conflict is unresolved, and the relationship between this headquarters gathering and the separately reported 28 January gathering is not settled. The common union-law campaign does not prove one continuous or duplicate event. Original codebook/baseline review and human review remain pending. A search-only Al-Araby result S031 has a headline about a protest against strike/union-rights laws, but its date, attendance, and relationship to this gathering are unknown; it is not used as event-field evidence.
open_questions: Can a contemporaneous source resolve whether the headquarters gathering was 24, 25, or 26 January?
Was the disputed-date headquarters gathering separate from the 28 January gathering or one mobilization described at different stages?
Can attendee evidence establish at least 50 people?
What was the physical end and event-specific state response?
Can the held Al-Araby search-only lead be assigned to a date or gathering by permitted independent reporting?

title: UGTA gathering on the Maison du Peuple esplanade against draft union and strike laws
location: Maison du Peuple esplanade (UGTA headquarters), Algiers, Algeria
scope: A single Algiers gathering attended by UGTA cadres from several federations and wilayas; national organizer reach does not establish a nationwide set of simultaneous protests.
organizer: UGTA cadres and federations, including wilaya union officials.
threshold_50_evidence: Pending. Opened reports confirm the gathering and its demand but give no numeric count; one calls it a large mobilization without a number. S016’s search-only result says “hundreds” but its body could not be retrieved after fresh manual-reviewed checks, so that phrase is not used as attendee evidence or a minimum.

occurrence.summary: Anadolu and Le Matin d’Algérie report that UGTA cadres/federations gathered on the Maison du Peuple esplanade on Saturday 28 January.

start_date.summary: Both opened reports identify Saturday 28 January 2023.

location.summary: Both opened reports identify the Maison du Peuple esplanade in Algiers.

organizer.summary: Anadolu identifies federation and wilaya union officials; Le Matin describes UGTA cadres from several federations and wilayas.

demands.summary: Participants opposed draft laws on union activity and collective labor disputes/strike rights; slogans are reported against restrictions on unions.

participants_original.summary: The opened reports do not give a number. S021 says “large mobilization” qualitatively. S016’s result snippet says hundreds of representatives, but the article body is unread and cannot substantiate a count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The opened material has no numerical estimate; the only numeric-size claim is in a search-only S016 snippet and is not accepted without a readable body.

protester_violence.summary: The reports do not establish event-specific protester violence or its absence.

state_response.summary: No event-specific evidence establishes any of the seven coded state-response dimensions; each remains unknown.

end_date.summary: Neither report establishes the physical end of the gathering.

notes: S004 and S021 are distinct outlets with contemporary reports; no source is treated as numeric corroboration. S016 could not be read because of technical failures after clean access checks. The January headquarters date conflict concerns an earlier reported gathering; relationship between the actions remains unresolved.
open_questions: Can body-verified attendance establish at least 50 people?
Did the gathering end the same day, and what was its physical end?
What event-specific state response occurred, if any?
Was this a distinct January 28 gathering or an action in the same sequence as the disputed-date headquarters gathering?
